definition_record.definition: Report mean per-bit agreement and exact recovery of all payload bits.
definition_record.replay_mapping: Per-bit agreement divides matching sites by the declared 24-bit payload, so deleted sites count as incorrect. Exact recovery requires all 24 sites to survive and match.

imported_definition: Per-bit payload accuracy and exact whole-message recovery
reason_full_system_not_executed: Requires trained checkpoints and CUDA evaluation outside the frozen CPU-only no-model contract
